Episode Notes:
The United States, Denmark, and Greenland have signed a new security agreement updating the 1951 Greenland Defense Agreement, easing more than a year of tension sparked by U.S. President Donald Trump's threats to take control of the island. Torrey Taussig joins Nicole on this episode of the Warcast to explain why the deal is a win for all three parties and what it means for Arctic security.
